descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 We are looking for a hands-on DataOps and Data Quality Engineer who can combine Microsoft Fabric engineering with automated data quality, monitoring and operational reliability. The role is primarily technical and focuses on turning governance and quality requirements into automated controls, observability and robust platform processes while remaining flexible enough to support broader data engineering activities when required.
 What You'll Be Doing
Design and implement automated data quality controls within Microsoft Fabric to ensure reliable and trustworthy reporting data
Translate data quality and governance requirements into executable validation rules, monitoring checks and quality gates
Build automated checks for data freshness, completeness, duplicates, schema changes, data volumes, key-field validity and other agreed business rules
Develop centralized monitoring and logging for pipeline runs, source arrival times, row counts, errors and data quality results
Create alerting and operational views to identify missing data, abnormal volume drops, failed loads and broken dependencies before they impact KPI reporting
Define reusable quality gate patterns and automated actions such as warnings, quarantine, reprocessing and escalation
Support and improve Microsoft Fabric pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, notebooks and SQL/Python-based processes
Implement robust pipeline patterns including retries, incremental loads, backfills, error handling and controlled reprocessing
Support ingestion from APIs, files, ADX/Kusto and other enterprise data sources when required
Embed data quality controls across ingestion, transformation and curated-data layers rather than relying on manual validation
Apply configuration-driven engineering patterns, environment separation, Git/CI/CD and deployment best practices
Troubleshoot data and pipeline incidents, perform root cause analysis and support controlled recovery
Document thresholds, dependencies, data contracts, runbooks and recovery procedures
Collaborate closely with Data Governance, Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Semantic Model and BI teams to improve overall platform reliability
 What You'll Bring Along
3+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering, DataOps, Data Quality Automation, Analytics Engineering or a related back-end data role
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric or Azure data platforms
Strong practical experience with Microsoft Fabric components such as Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Lakehouse/Warehouse, notebooks and SQL-based processing
Experience implementing automated data quality checks, monitoring, logging, alerting or operational controls around production data pipelines
Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Python and/or PySpark for validation, automation and data transformation
Experience supporting API, file, database or enterprise-source ingestion
Good understanding of error handling, incremental loads, retries, backfills and controlled reprocessing
Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills
Structured approach to documentation and operational procedures
Ability to work effectively across Governance, Architecture, Data Engineering and BI teams
Good English communication skills
Nice to have
Experience integrating ADX/Kusto with Microsoft Fabric or Power BI
Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Eventstream, CDC or mirroring patterns
Experience with data testing or observability frameworks such as dbt tests, Great Expectations, Soda or similar tools
Experience with Git, CI/CD, environment promotion and automated deployment practices for data assets
Knowledge of Microsoft Purview, lineage, metadata management, sensitivity labels or enterprise governance tooling
Experience working in production reporting environments with strong operational and reliability requirements
